caption: The drawing depicts a woman standing and facing forward, wearing a dress with a full, long skirt that features a red and white or pink and white plaid pattern, with blue bands at the hem. Over her shoulders, she has a blue shawl that is draped into a V-shape across a white lace-edged collar. She also wears a pink apron with a blue border that is tied at the waist and hangs down in a triangular shape at the front. Her head is covered with a large, wide-brimmed hat in beige with a pink bow on top and blue detailing at the center of the bow. Her shoes are black, and her hands are visible at her sides. The drawing is signed or labeled "Bertha Sample." The background is plain and a light cream color, and there are thin vertical lines intersecting the woman's figure.
title: Puppet - "Liza"
